verdict.rationale: Sentry's own docs say it ingests OpenTelemetry traces and logs through OTLP endpoints, either directly from an OTel SDK or via the OpenTelemetry Collector, which covers sending telemetry directly over OTLP. The evidence is a single concept-page mention, so the depth of the OTel support is thinly documented. Missing for 10: evidence of OTLP metrics ingest, detailed endpoint/auth setup documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of the OTLP ingest path.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send telemetry directly over OTLP with first-class OpenTelemetry support

citations.quote: Sentry can ingest OpenTelemetry traces and logs via OTLP endpoints, either directly from an OTel SDK or through a pipeline tool like the OpenTelemetry Collector.
